{{Use dmy dates|date=October 2022}}
{{Use Indian English|date=October 2022}}

The '''Indian Olympic archery team''' competes at the [[Summer Olympic Games]] in the sport of [[archery]].

India first entered an archery team for the [[Summer Olympic Games]] in 1988, at the [[1988 Summer Olympics|Seoul Summer games]].<ref name=1988Entry>{{cite web|url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/countries/IND/summer/1988/ARC/ |title=India Archery at the 1988 Seoul Summer Games |publisher=Sports-Reference |accessdate=23 July 2012 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20121113003226/http://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/countries/IND/summer/1988/ARC/ |archivedate=13 November 2012 }}</ref>

India entered three archers at the [[1992 Summer Olympics|1992 Barcelona Olympics]]<ref name=1992Entry>{{cite web|url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/countries/IND/summer/1992/ARC/ |title=India Archery at the 1992 Barcelona Summer Games |publisher=Sports-Reference |accessdate=23 July 2012 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20121113102249/http://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/countries/IND/summer/1992/ARC/ |archivedate=13 November 2012 }}</ref>

India entered three archers at the [[1996 Summer Olympics|1996 Atlanta Olympics]]<ref name=1996Entry>{{cite web|url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/countries/IND/summer/1996/ARC/ |title=India Archery at the 1996 Atlanta Summer Games |publisher=Sports-Reference |accessdate=23 July 2012 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20121113102318/http://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/countries/IND/summer/1996/ARC/ |archivedate=13 November 2012 }}</ref>

India entered six person [[archery]] team at the [[2004 Summer Olympics|2004 Athens Olympics]]<ref name=2004Entry>{{cite news|url=http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/Indian-archers-qualify-for-Athens-Olympics/articleshow/85088.cms|title=Indian archers qualify for Athens Olympics|date=20 July 2003|publisher=Times of India|accessdate=23 July 2012}}</ref><ref name="reena">{{cite web|url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/countries/IND/summer/2004/ARC/ |title=India Archery at the 2004 Athens Summer Games |publisher=Sports-Reference |accessdate=23 July 2012 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20121106121048/http://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/countries/IND/summer/2004/ARC/ |archivedate=6 November 2012 }}</ref>

India entered four archers at the [[2008 Summer Olympics|Beijing Olympics]] in 2008.<ref name=2008Entry>{{cite web|url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/countries/IND/summer/2008/ARC/ |title=India Archery at the 2008 Beijing Summer Games |publisher=Sports-Reference |accessdate=23 July 2012 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20151012113847/http://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/countries/IND/summer/2008/ARC/ |archivedate=12 October 2015 }}</ref><ref name="bombayala devi">{{cite web|url=http://daily.bhaskar.com/article/SPO-OLY-laishram-bombayla-devi-one-of-the-three-musketeers-of-indian-archery-team-3527968.html|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160303232321/http://daily.bhaskar.com/article/SPO-OLY-laishram-bombayla-devi-one-of-the-three-musketeers-of-indian-archery-team-3527968.html|url-status=dead|archive-date=3 March 2016|title=Bombayla Devi: One of the three musketeers of Indian archery team}}</ref><ref name="Dola Banerjee">{{cite web|url=http://www.iloveindia.com/sports/archery/indian-archers/dola-banerjee.html|title=Dola Banerjee|accessdate=23 July 2012}}{{Dead link|date=August 2025 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref><ref name="Mangal">{{cite news|url=http://www.articles.timesofindia.indiatimes.com/2012-03-14/ranchi/31195403_1_mangal-singh-champia-archery-world-cup-joa|work=[[The Times of India]]|title=Jharkhand olympic association to go all out for Champia|accessdate=23 July 2012}}{{dead link|date=October 2024|bot=medic}}{{cbignore|bot=medic}}</ref>

India entered with a six-person [[archery]] team in the [[London 2012 Olympics]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://post.jagran.com/Deepika-leads-Indian-archers-Olympic-dream-in-London-1341493110|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304064259/http://post.jagran.com/Deepika-leads-Indian-archers-Olympic-dream-in-London-1341493110|url-status=dead|archive-date=4 March 2016|title = English News Headlines: Latest News Today, Breaking News from India & World}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.thehindu.com/sport/other-sports/article3640194.ece |title=Sport / Other Sports : Warm send-off for Indian archery squad |work=The Hindu |date=2012-07-15 |accessdate=2012-07-23 |location=Chennai, India}}</ref><ref name="thehindu">{{cite news| url=http://www.thehindu.com/life-and-style/kids/article3672725.ece | location=Chennai, India | work=The Hindu | first=Madhumitha | last=Srinivasan | title=India in London | date=23 July 2012}}</ref><ref name="bare_url">{{Cite web|url=http://olympicgoldquest.in/index.php?option=com_phocagallery&view=category&id=2&Itemid=2&cid=30|title = Olympic Gold Quest}}</ref>

In the [[2016 Olympics|Rio 2016 Olympics]], India's [[Atanu Das]] was the only individual from the Men's team to reach the Final, finishing equal 9th.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.olympic.org/rio-2016/archery/individual-competition-men|title=Rio 2016 Individual Competition men - Olympic Archery|date=2019-03-08|website=International Olympic Committee|language=en|access-date=2020-03-26}}</ref> In the Women's individual competition, [[Bombayla Devi Laishram]] and [[Deepika Kumari]] finished equal 9th and [[Laxmirani Majhi]] finished equal 33rd.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.olympic.org/rio-2016/archery/individual-competition-women|title=Rio 2016 Individual Competition women - Olympic Archery|date=2019-03-08|website=International Olympic Committee|language=en|access-date=2020-03-26}}</ref>

== Paris Olympics 2024 Indian archery team members ==
India sent six archers to the [[2024 Summer Olympics and Paralympics cauldron|2024 Paris Olympics]], filling its quota for the first time since the 2012 London Olympics.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Nag |first=Utathya |title=Paris 2024 Olympics archery: Deepika Kumari, Tarundeep Rai set for fourth Summer Games appearance |url=https://www.olympics.com/en/news/india-archery-team-paris-2024-olympics-squad-list |access-date=2025-10-29 |website=Olympics.com}}</ref> 

The team of [[Dhiraj Bommadevara]] and [[Ankita Bhakat]] finished fourth in the recurve mixed team event, India's best result at the Olympics.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Nag |first=Utathya |date=2024-08-03 |title=Paris 2024 Olympics: India’s archery results and scores for all events - full list |url=https://www.olympics.com/en/news/paris-2024-olympics-archery-india-results-scores |access-date=2025-10-29 |website=Olympics.com}}</ref>

The Indian men's archery team of Jayanta Talukdar, Rahul Banerjee and Tarundeep Rai was knocked out of the London Olympics on the opening day.<ref>{{cite news| url= http://www.thehindu.com/sport/other-sports/article3696209.ece|title= Men's archery team knocked out of Olympics| date= 28 July 2012 | location=Chennai, India| work=The Hindu| first=Kamesh| last=Srinivasan}}</ref>
